scope: explicit persistent-stream native phase diagnostic, eight Rust files

resolved_findings.finding: remaining(deadline)? inside the diagnostic IO closure could label a pre-syscall deadline failure as a timeout-setter failure.
resolved_findings.resolution: All five deadline prechecks now execute once before IO observation; real TCP-pair control checks no setter event is emitted for expired read/write/flush/timeout operations.
The unchanged client_timeout function moved to existing managed_resident_client_stream and is reexported; the parent file has 500 lines.

invariants_reviewed: The feature-only command enters the existing persistent per-frame loop and lifetime lease, retaining the original started_at, payload-derived deadline and one managed request call.
Default-build observation macros erase to the original expression or nothing; the explicit diagnostic command and frame export are feature-only.
Authentication, detailed fatal versus retryable classification, original safe-error mapping and original frame write Result are retained.
The macOS read-buffer fallback remains unchanged; wrappers record existing operations and their Results.
Payload and response digests are computed only after the original stdout-frame write; raw request bytes, tokens, endpoint strings and arbitrary error messages are not exported.
Events are bounded16per frame, diagnostic reports128per stream plus one fixed cap marker, report bytes16384; error labels are finite and timings clipped with incomplete evidence.

Events are bounded to 16 per frame, diagnostic reports to 128 per stream plus one fixed cap marker, and report size to 16384 bytes; error labels are finite and timings are clipped with incomplete evidence recorded.
Result pointer/value preservation and no extra request are controlled in the source tests; no installed workload result is inferred from those finite controls.
validation_scope: Read-only source/callsite review; no Cargo or runtime tests executed by reviewer.
limits: Diagnostic observations can affect scheduling and are ineligible for headline timing.
Actual failing warmed persistent-client workload still needs hosted execution.
The reader and driver source are separately owned; final whole-driver source binding must be reviewed and frozen by their owner.
